overview: A single mother, with dreams of becoming a writer, has a son at the age of 15 in 1965, and goes through a failed marriage with the drug-addicted father.
tagline: One day can make your life; one day can ruin your life. All life is is four or five big days that change everything.

recs.blurb: In New York, a struggling actress and a successful writer sing about their failed marriage from two perspectives.
